ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (dark grey/black) across >90% of visible surface; high-intensity (white/tan) pixels are restricted to localized distal clusters and edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark grey field; two circular light-grey focal blobs on the medial-central portion of the left lobe; dense, contiguous high-contrast white/tan pixel clusters mapped to the outer 15% of the leading edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression; approximate 35-degree angle visible above the high-frequency white-water splash zone obscuring the lower vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows regular, low-amplitude serrations (~2-4 pixel depth); right lobe trailing edge displays extremely irregular, high-amplitude jagged indentations (20-60 pixel depth) representing significant structural truncation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to the outer leading edges of both lobes, terminating in acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups concentrated along the leading edge tips and distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three faint, parallel vertical-oriented linear pixel disruptions of higher intensity relative to the background dark pigmentation on the left lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular tissue loss and jagged truncation along the majority of the visible trailing edge of the right lobe lobe compared to the more intact profile of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive three-dimensional textured encrustation of high-contrast material forming a distinct border along the leading edges of the fluke tips.
